intent: The signature Jira-style status pill: a small uppercase label communicating workflow state (To do, In progress, Done...). Use it wherever an item's status must be scannable at a glance — issue cards, tables, detail headers. It is purely presentational text; it is not interactive.
a11yNotes: Text content is the accessible name — keep it meaningful (the visible status word). Color is never the only signal since the label text carries the state. The base .lozenge class has no background of its own: a status variant class is mandatory. Max width is 200px with truncation; avoid statuses long enough to truncate.
